::: {.sx-lede}
I am a physics PhD student at TCU working with Dr. Kathleen Barger on integral
field spectroscopy of the Large Magellanic Cloud. Before that I studied physics
at Utah Valley University and spent a summer with the PAndAS team at the
University of Michigan.
:::

## Research

**Current focus.** Emission-line maps of 30 Doradus, the Tarantula Nebula, from
SDSS-V Local Volume Mapper integral field spectroscopy: coadded line-flux maps,
dust extinction from Balmer decrements, de-reddened maps, and spatially resolved
line-ratio diagnostics, aimed at the flow of gas in and around the region.

**Areas.**

- Emission-line spectroscopy and Balmer decrements
- Dust extinction in the Large Magellanic Cloud
- Integral field spectroscopy data pipelines
- Extracting physical parameters from large spectroscopic data sets

::: {.sx-entry}
::: {.sx-entry__head}
[NSF Physics REU]{.sx-entry__title}
[June 2022 – 2023]{.sx-entry__when}
:::
[University of Michigan, Department of Astronomy]{.sx-entry__where}

- Advisor: Dr. Eric Bell
- *Islands no more: the important mergers of nearby galaxies and their effects.*
  Searched for faint satellites around Andromeda using number-density
  variations of RGB stars in the PAndAS survey, reduced Gemini follow-up
  imaging and built photometric catalogs of candidates, then worked on Hubble
  Space Telescope follow-up. Contributed to the discovery of Andromeda XXXV.
:::

::: {.sx-entry}
::: {.sx-entry__head}
[Undergraduate Researcher]{.sx-entry__title}
[May 2020 – 2023]{.sx-entry__when}
:::
[Utah Valley University, Department of Physics]{.sx-entry__where}

- Advisor: Dr. Christian Draper
- *Emission Expedition: a spectral survey of 800,000 galaxies.* Used the
  spectra of 792,503 galaxies from SDSS Data Release 16, binned by redshift, to
  measure how the fraction of galaxies showing each of 17 visible emission lines
  changes with redshift. Calculated star formation rates and used BPT diagrams
  to diagnose the origin of the emission.
:::
